operator.startup_semantics: Captured-output startup only. Validate existing protected root, state, lock, exact database path and file ACLs; reject missing database and pending credential publication. Under the existing exclusive bounded operator lock, use existing issuer verification/store preparation and return the verified runtime in captured memory. This does not enroll, renew, rotate, publish handoffs or create a substitute database.
operator.sidecar_lifetime: SQLite may remove WAL/SHM when the last writer closes. Startup verification may prepare the existing store; the backend then opens its normal writer directly without a second strict read-only call in between. No permanent auxiliary writer is required.
operator.reader_semantics: Status, Runtime and Read-Facts retain verify-readonly/facts-readonly and never prepare a store. Missing required reader resources fail closed.

callers.runtime_output: Captured only; no plaintext credentials in evidence or logs.

preservation: Existing Node issuer/store, schemas and bounded transaction semantics unchanged
Existing identities, TEST history, encrypted state and finite credential policies preserved
No browser login, default password or global token for services
Normal ingestion, Brain submission and dispatch OFF; LIVE_REAL DISABLED
No strategy, telemetry writer, ledger, Library or unrelated service changes
acceptance: Require exact pins, two actual no-sidecar private cold-start/shutdown cycles, missing-database fail-closed test, caller and read-only regression checks, deployed website-only restart, readiness and ledger parity. Historical source certification alone is not deployed acceptance.
scope_boundary: This host contract grants no physical-fact approval, service enrollment, run activation, human approval or later-card authority. Those require their separate verified owner artifacts and bounded authorization.
